T1143.long: The configurations for how applications run on macOS and OS X are listed in property list (plist) files. One of the tags in these files can be apple.awt.UIElement, which allows for Java applications to prevent the application's icon from appearing in the Dock. A common use for this is when applications run in the system tray, but don't also want to show up in the Dock. However, adversaries can abuse this feature and hide their running window  .

CopyFiles=_CopyFiles_sys_x86
[_Install.ntx86.HW]
AddReg=_AddReg_HW, _AddReg_Intf
[_Install.ntx86.Services]
AddService = DisplayLinkUsbIo, 0x00000002, _AddService_x86, _EventLog_x86

HKR,,TypesSupported,  %REG_DWORD%,7


;******************************************************************************

CopyFiles=_CopyFiles_sys_x64
[_Install.ntamd64.HW]
AddReg=_AddReg_HW, _AddReg_Intf
[_Install.ntamd64.Services]
AddService = DisplayLinkUsbIo_x64, 0x00000002, _AddService_x64, _EventLog_x64

[_InstallDFU.ntamd64]
CopyFiles=_CopyFiles_sys_x64
[_InstallDFU.ntamd64.HW]
AddReg=_AddReg_HW, _AddReg_IntfDFU
[_InstallDFU.ntamd64.Services]
AddService = DisplayLinkUsbIo_x64, 0x00000002, _AddService_x64, _EventLog_x64

[_AddService_x64]

ServiceBinary  = %12%\DisplayLinkUsbIo_x64_%VerSuffix%.sys

[_EventLog_x64]
AddReg=_EventLog_x64_AddReg

HKR,,EventMessageFile,%REG_EXPAND_SZ%,"%%SystemRoot%%\System32\IoLogMsg.dll;%%SystemRoot%%\System32\drivers\DisplayLinkUsbIo_x64_%VerSuffix%.sys"
